results.title: Stanford Stadium - Facts, figures, pictures and more of the Stanford Cardinal college football stadium
results.snippet: The stadium was completed in time for the Cardinals to play the Golden Bears on November 19, 1921. Built at a cost of just over $500,000, Stanford Stadium had a seating capacity of 60,000. The original one tier grandstand was constructed in a horseshoe shape.
